name: Nationality by Descent / Birth

requirement_groups.name: Filiation or birth in Burkina Faso

requirements.blocker_text: The new Code des personnes et de la famille (Loi n.012-2025/ALT, effective September 2025, replacing the 1989 code) maintains the two classical pathways at Articles 152-1 through 152-11: nationality by filiation (descent from a Burkinabe parent) and nationality by birth on Burkinabe territory. An academic legal analysis of the new code describes both as gender-neutral, preserving the egalitarian principle that either parent can transmit nationality.

sources.title: AFRILEX (University of Bordeaux law journal) -- academic legal analysis of Burkinabe nationality under the new 2025 Code des personnes et de la famille, Articles 152-1 to 152-11 (attribution of nationality at birth)
